description: Output structure for advice form submissions sent to the CWT API

broad_work_type.description: Broad casework category, e.g. 'S28i Advice' or 'Other casework'

detailed_work_type.description: Detailed casework category, e.g. 'SSSI - Pre Consent advice'

description.description: Work type, activity and site names; unlimited length

consulting_body_type.description: CWT consulting body type derived from the applicant category

consulting_body.description: Name of the consulting body or individual

customer_name.description: Full name of the person submitting the form

customer_email_address.description: Email address of the person submitting the form

email_header.description: Same content as description, limited to 254 characters

public_body_type.description: Type of public body the applicant works on behalf of

public_body.description: Name of the public body the applicant works for

is_there_a_european_site.description: 'Yes' when European sites are affected, otherwise empty
